```{r load-benchmark-tsv}
step_labels <- c(
  simulate_genome = "Simulate genome",
  index_genome    = "Index genome",
  simulate_reads  = "Simulate reads",
  align           = "Align reads",
  sort_bam        = "Sort BAM",
  index_bam       = "Index BAM",
  markdup         = "Mark duplicates",
  index_markdup   = "Index markdup",
  faidx_genome    = "Faidx genome",
  call_variants   = "Call variants"
)

steps <- names(step_labels)

ts_facet_labels <- c(
  "Simulate reads" = "Simulate\nreads",
  "Align reads" = "Align\nreads",
  "Sort BAM" = "Sort\nBAM",
  "Mark duplicates" = "Mark\nduplicates",
  "Call variants" = "Call\nvariants"
)

read_benchmarks <- function(outdir, condition) {
  lapply(steps, function(step) {
    path <- file.path(outdir, "benchmarks", paste0(step, ".tsv"))
    df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
    df$step <- step
    df$condition <- condition
    df$repeat_id <- seq_len(nrow(df))
    df
  }) |> bind_rows()
}

baseline     <- read_benchmarks("results_baseline",    "Snakemake")
denet_wrap   <- read_benchmarks("results_denet",        "Snakemake + denet wrap")
# native mode (`make denet-native`): the benchmark TSVs are filled by denet
# instead of psutil; optional, so the report renders without it
have_native  <- dir.exists("results_denet_native")
denet_native <- if (have_native) read_benchmarks("results_denet_native", "Snakemake + denet native")

condition_levels <- c("Snakemake", "Snakemake + denet wrap", "Snakemake + denet native")[c(TRUE, TRUE, have_native)]

bench <- bind_rows(baseline, denet_wrap, denet_native) |>
  mutate(
    step_label = factor(step_labels[step], levels = step_labels),
    condition  = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels)
  )
```

```{r load-denet-jsonl}
denet_metrics_dir <- "results_denet/denet_metrics"

denet_files <- list.files(denet_metrics_dir, pattern = "\\.jsonl$", full.names = TRUE)

# denet >= 0.8 tags every JSONL record with a "kind" discriminator
# (env | metadata | tree); older releases emitted untagged records where
# metadata began with {"pid": and samples with {"ts_ms":. Detect which layout a
# file uses and accept both, so runs recorded with either version still load.
# In both layouts the tree-level aggregate lives under $aggregated.
read_denet_jsonl <- function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)

  tagged <- any(str_detect(lines, '^\\{"kind"'))
  if (tagged) {
    is_meta   <- str_detect(lines, '"kind"\\s*:\\s*"metadata"')
    is_sample <- str_detect(lines, '"kind"\\s*:\\s*"tree"')
  } else {
    is_meta   <- str_detect(lines, '^\\{"pid":')
    is_sample <- str_detect(lines, '^\\{"ts_ms":')
  }

  # Each benchmark repeat appends a metadata record followed by its samples.
  meta_idx <- which(is_meta)
  if (length(meta_idx) == 0) meta_idx <- 0L

  bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(meta_idx), function(i) {
    start <- meta_idx[i] + 1
    end   <- if (i < length(meta_idx)) meta_idx[i + 1] - 1 else length(lines)
    if (start > end) return(NULL)
    block <- lines[start:end][is_sample[start:end]]
    if (length(block) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- bind_rows(lapply(block, function(l) {
      agg <- fromJSON(l)$aggregated
      data.frame(
        ts_ms         = as.numeric(agg$ts_ms),
        cpu_usage     = as.numeric(agg$cpu_usage),
        mem_rss_mb    = as.numeric(agg$mem_rss_kb) / 1024,
        disk_write_mb = as.numeric(agg$disk_write_bytes) / 1024^2
      )
    })) |> arrange(ts_ms)
    df$time_s <- (df$ts_ms - df$ts_ms[1]) / 1000
    df$repeat_id <- i
    df
  }))
}

# One file per repeat, <step>.<ns timestamp>.jsonl; the timestamp orders the repeats.
# Older runs wrote <step>.jsonl with all repeats appended; the in-file split above
# still numbers those.
denet_ts <- lapply(denet_files, function(f) {
  df <- read_denet_jsonl(f)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df$step    <- str_remove(basename(f), "(\\.\\d+)?\\.jsonl$")
  df$file_ts <- as.numeric(str_match(basename(f), "\\.(\\d+)\\.jsonl$")[, 2])
  df
}) |> bind_rows() |>
  group_by(step) |>
  mutate(repeat_id = if (all(is.na(file_ts))) repeat_id else dense_rank(file_ts)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-file_ts) |>
  mutate(step_label = factor(step_labels[step], levels = step_labels))

stopifnot(nrow(denet_ts) > 0)
```

```{r fig-wall-time}
# n_repeats is read from data so the subtitle stays accurate if benchmark_repeats changes
n_repeats <- bench |>
  distinct(step_label, condition, repeat_id) |>
  count(step_label, condition) |>
  pull(n) |>
  max()

bench_summary <- bench |>
  group_by(step_label, condition) |>
  summarise(
    mean_s = mean(s),
    sd_s   = sd(s),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Error bars show +/- 1 SD across repeats.
# SD (rather than SE or CV) is used because we want to convey the absolute
# run-to-run spread in seconds, not the precision of the mean estimate.
p_time <- ggplot(bench_summary,
       aes(x = step_label, y = mean_s, fill = condition,
           ymin = pmax(mean_s - sd_s, 0), ymax = mean_s + sd_s)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p",
                     breaks = c(0, 1, 3, 10, 30, 100),
                     minor_breaks = c(0.5, 2, 5, 20, 50),
                     labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Snakemake" = "#4C72B0",
                               "Snakemake + denet wrap" = "#DD8452",
                               "Snakemake + denet native" = "#55A868")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Wall-clock time (s, log1p scale)", fill = NULL,
       title = "A  Wall-clock time per step",
       subtitle = paste0("mean +/- 1 SD, n = ", n_repeats, " repeats")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r load-markdup-variants}
# markdup re-run per mate-grouping variant (wrap mode, markdup_phase_log=true;
# `make markdup-variants`). Optional: the chunk and figure are skipped when the
# directories are absent (e.g. in CI).
markdup_dirs <- c(sort = "results_markdup_sort", collate_fast = "results_markdup_collate_fast")
have_markdup <- all(dir.exists(markdup_dirs))
```

```{r markdup-perprocess, eval=have_markdup, fig.height=9.5, fig.cap="Duplicate marking at 30x, per process, for one repeat of each variant (wrap mode). All axes linear. Top: resident memory (GB) stacked by process (processes under 100 MB are listed, as they do not show at this scale). Middle: cumulative disk writes (GB) stacked by process (temporary spill files of the sorts, and markdup's output). Bottom: CPU per process (100% = one core), one lane per pipeline position. Dashed lines are events logged by the pipeline itself (markdup_phase_log), on the same clock as denet's samples: a sort starting to merge its temporary spill files, and the mate-grouping stage exiting. Processes are named from denet's per-child command-line records (denet >= 0.10)."}
stage_names <- list(sort = c("sort -n", "fixmate", "sort", "markdup"),
                    collate_fast = c("collate -f", "fixmate", "sort", "markdup"))
variant_labels <- c(sort = "samtools sort -n | fixmate | sort | markdup",
                    collate_fast = "samtools collate -f | fixmate | sort | markdup")

# denet >= 0.10 writes a `child` record with each child's full command line;
# name samtools processes by subcommand from it
child_stages <- function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[str_detect(lines, '"kind"\\s*:\\s*"child"')]
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(lapply(lines, function(l) {
    rec <- fromJSON(l)
    cmd <- rec$cmd
    if (length(cmd) < 2 || !str_detect(cmd[1], "samtools$")) return(NULL)
    stage <- switch(cmd[2],
                    sort = if ("-n" %in% cmd) "sort -n" else "sort",
                    collate = if ("-f" %in% cmd) "collate -f" else "collate",
                    fixmate = "fixmate", markdup = "markdup", NA_character_)
    data.frame(pid = rec$pid, stage = stage)
  })) |> filter(!is.na(stage)) |> distinct(pid, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

read_children <- function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[str_detect(lines, '"kind"\\s*:\\s*"tree"')]
  bind_rows(lapply(lines, function(l) {
    rec <- fromJSON(l)
    ch <- rec$children
    if (is.null(ch) || length(ch) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(ts_ms = rec$ts_ms, pid = ch$pid, command = ch$command,
               rss_gb = ch$metrics$mem_rss_kb / 1024^2,
               cpu = ch$metrics$cpu_usage,
               write_gb = ch$metrics$disk_write_bytes / 1024^3)
  }))
}

md <- bind_rows(lapply(names(markdup_dirs), function(v) {
  f <- sort(list.files(file.path(markdup_dirs[[v]], "denet_metrics"),
                       pattern = "^markdup\\..*\\.jsonl$", full.names = TRUE))[1]
  df <- read_children(f) |> filter(command == "samtools")
  t0 <- min(df$ts_ms)
  named <- child_stages(f)
  if (!is.null(named) && nrow(named) >= 4) {
    df <- df |> inner_join(named, by = "pid")
  } else {
    # older denet: label by pipeline position (PID order)
    pids <- sort(unique(df$pid))[1:4]
    df <- df |> filter(pid %in% pids) |> mutate(stage = stage_names[[v]][match(pid, pids)])
  }
  df |> mutate(variant = v, t0 = t0, t1 = max(ts_ms), time_s = (ts_ms - t0) / 1000)
}))

events <- bind_rows(lapply(names(markdup_dirs), function(v) {
  ph <- read.delim(file.path(markdup_dirs[[v]], "logs", "markdup.phases.tsv"),
                   header = FALSE, col.names = c("ts_ms", "what", "detail"),
                   quote = "", colClasses = c("numeric", "character", "character"))
  win <- md |> filter(variant == v) |> slice(1)
  ph |>
    filter(ts_ms >= win$t0 - 1000, ts_ms <= win$t1 + 1000) |>
    mutate(label = case_when(
      str_detect(detail, "merging from") & what == "group" ~ paste(stage_names[[v]][1], "merges spills"),
      str_detect(detail, "merging from") & what == "sort" ~ "sort merges spills",
      what == "end" & detail == "group" ~ paste(stage_names[[v]][1], "exits"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
    filter(!is.na(label)) |>
    mutate(variant = v, time_s = (ts_ms - win$t0) / 1000) |>
    # events within a second of each other (e.g. the name sort exiting and the
    # coordinate sort starting its merge) share one marker and one label
    arrange(time_s) |>
    mutate(grp = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(time_s) > 1))) |>
    group_by(variant, grp) |>
    summarise(time_s = min(time_s), label = paste(label, collapse = " / "), .groups = "drop")
}))

md <- md |> mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = unique(unlist(stage_names))[c(1, 5, 2, 3, 4)]),
                   variant = factor(variant_labels[variant], levels = variant_labels))
events <- events |> mutate(variant = factor(variant_labels[variant], levels = variant_labels))
stage_cols <- c("sort -n" = "#C44E52", "collate -f" = "#8172B2", "fixmate" = "#55A868",
                "sort" = "#4C72B0", "markdup" = "#DD8452")

# stacking needs every process at every sample time
md_stack <- md |>
  select(variant, time_s, stage, rss_gb) |>
  complete(nesting(variant, time_s), stage, fill = list(rss_gb = 0)) |>
  filter(!is.na(stage))

# cumulative writes stay on disk after a process exits: carry each process's
# last value forward (and 0 before it is first seen)
md_write <- md |>
  select(variant, time_s, stage, write_gb) |>
  complete(nesting(variant, time_s), stage) |>
  filter(!is.na(stage)) |>
  group_by(variant, stage) |> arrange(time_s, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  fill(write_gb, .direction = "down") |>
  mutate(write_gb = coalesce(write_gb, 0)) |>
  ungroup()

small <- md |> group_by(variant, stage) |> summarise(peak_mb = max(rss_gb) * 1024, .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(peak_mb < 100) |> group_by(variant) |>
  summarise(txt = paste0("too small to see: ", paste(sprintf("%s %.0f MB", stage, peak_mb), collapse = ", ")), .groups = "drop")

peaks <- md_stack |> group_by(variant, time_s) |> summarise(tot = sum(rss_gb), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(variant) |> summarise(peak = max(tot), dur = max(time_s), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(txt = sprintf("peak %.2f GB, %.0f s", peak, dur))

p_md_mem <- ggplot(md_stack, aes(time_s, rss_gb, fill = stage)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(data = events, aes(xintercept = time_s), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = events, aes(x = time_s, y = Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            angle = 90, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = peaks, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = txt), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(data = small, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = txt), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1.02, vjust = 3.4, size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~variant, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stage_cols, drop = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "RSS (GB)", fill = "process") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

# one lane per pipeline position, so no process's CPU is drawn under another's
md <- md |> mutate(lane = factor(ifelse(stage %in% c("sort -n", "collate -f"), "group mates", as.character(stage)),
                                 levels = c("group mates", "fixmate", "sort", "markdup")))
written <- md_write |> group_by(variant, time_s) |> summarise(tot = sum(write_gb), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(variant) |> summarise(txt = sprintf("%.2f GB written", max(tot)), .groups = "drop")

p_md_io <- ggplot(md_write, aes(time_s, write_gb, fill = stage)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(data = events, aes(xintercept = time_s), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = written, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = txt), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~variant, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stage_cols, drop = TRUE, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Disk writes (GB)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_blank())

p_md_cpu <- ggplot(md, aes(time_s, cpu, colour = stage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = events, aes(xintercept = time_s), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(lane ~ variant, switch = "y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 100, 200)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = stage_cols, drop = TRUE, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Elapsed time (s)", y = "CPU (%)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 9),
        strip.text.x = element_blank())

fig_md <- (p_md_mem / p_md_io / p_md_cpu) + plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(2, 1, 3))
ggsave("figures/markdup_perprocess.pdf", fig_md, width = 12, height = 9.5)
fig_md
```

```{r figure-1, eval=have_markdup, fig.height=9.5, fig.cap="Figure 1. The value and the cost of per-process profiling. (D) Cost: difference from baseline (Snakemake's own benchmark, no denet) in wall-clock time (%) and peak resident memory (MB), per rule, for denet in wrap mode (a monitor process per job) and native mode (denet replaces Snakemake's psutil sampler), mean of 3 repeats; baseline runtime in brackets. Short rules pay a fixed ~0.3-0.5 s per job. In native mode denet is not part of the job's process tree, so its peak-RSS differences reflect sampling resolution (it catches brief peaks that psutil's 0.5 s/30 s schedule misses), not cost. Faidx genome (0.2 s) is omitted, where any fixed cost dominates in percent. (A-C) Value: the duplicate-marking rule, per process, for one repeat of the current pipeline and of the collate -f variant, as recorded by denet: resident memory (A) and cumulative disk writes (B) stacked by process, and CPU per process (C). Dashed lines are events logged by the pipeline itself on the same clock. All axes linear."}
cost <- bench |>
  filter(step != "faidx_genome") |>
  group_by(step, step_label, condition) |>
  summarise(wall = mean(s), rss = mean(as.numeric(max_rss), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
cost_base <- cost |> filter(condition == "Snakemake") |> select(step, wall0 = wall, rss0 = rss)
cost_d <- cost |>
  filter(condition != "Snakemake") |>
  left_join(cost_base, by = "step") |>
  mutate(`Wall time (%)` = 100 * (wall - wall0) / wall0,
         `Peak RSS (MB)` = rss - rss0,
         mode = str_remove(as.character(condition), "^Snakemake \\+ denet "),
         rule = paste0(step_label, " (", as.character(signif(wall0, 2)), " s)")) |>
  pivot_longer(c(`Wall time (%)`, `Peak RSS (MB)`), names_to = "metric", values_to = "delta") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Wall time (%)", "Peak RSS (MB)")))
rule_order <- cost_d |> distinct(step_label, rule) |> arrange(step_label) |> pull(rule)
cost_d <- cost_d |> mutate(rule = factor(rule, levels = rev(rule_order)))

# greys and shapes, so mode colours do not clash with the process colours in B-D
p_cost <- ggplot(cost_d, aes(delta, rule, colour = mode, shape = mode)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(wrap = "grey55", native = "black"), name = "denet mode") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(wrap = 1, native = 16), name = "denet mode") +
  labs(x = "Difference from baseline (linear)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig1 <- ((p_md_mem + labs(title = "A  Memory per process (markdup)")) /
         (p_md_io + labs(title = "B  Disk writes per process")) /
         (p_md_cpu + labs(title = "C  CPU per process")) +
         plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1, 3))) |
  (p_cost + labs(title = "D  Cost"))
fig1 <- fig1 + plot_layout(widths = c(2.6, 1), guides = "collect")
ggsave("figures/figure1.pdf", fig1, width = 15, height = 9.5)
fig1
```

```{r combined-figure, fig.height=12, fig.cap="Supplementary overview. Resource profiling of a simulated read alignment workflow. (A, B, C) Mean wall-clock time, peak RSS, and disk bytes written per pipeline step under three conditions: Snakemake (baseline, no denet), Snakemake + denet wrap (denet attached to each rule subprocess via a shell wrapper; the bars are still Snakemake's psutil measurements), and Snakemake + denet native (denet replaces Snakemake's psutil sampler, so the bars are denet's measurements; rules unchanged). Error bars are +/- 1 SD across benchmark repeats. SD was chosen over SE or CV to express absolute run-to-run variability in interpretable units. (D, E, F) CPU, RSS, and cumulative disk-write timeseries recorded by denet at 50 ms intervals for the wrap condition, faceted by rule in pipeline order, one line per repeat; each rule has its own linear y range (CPU: 100% = one core; disk writes cumulative). Elapsed time is relative to the start of each repeat. Faidx genome finishes before the first sample."}
fig <- (p_time | p_rss | p_io_bar) / p_cpu / p_mem / p_io +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(3, 2, 2, 2)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"))

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/figure_S_overview.pdf", fig, width = 12, height = 12)

fig
```
